title: Signal Scout onboarding screenshots: compact latency / cost / span timelines
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, mobile-friendly set of onboarding screenshots and documentation visuals (titled 'Signal Scout') that introduce new users to the Console's core observability surfaces: 1) latency ribbon and percentile breakdown, 2) per-token cost sparkline and model cost drilldown, 3) lightweight trace swimlane with span timelines, and 4) a condensed modal that surfaces top contributors to cost and high-latency spans. These assets will be used in the product Quickstart tour, docs landing, and release notes. The goal is to communicate signal quickly at small sizes (thumbnail / 360px wide) while remaining useful at full resolution. Deliverables: six screen compositions (three primary dashboards, one modal detail, one mini-timeline GIF, one annotated overlay), export presets for 1x/2x PNG and SVG callouts, and Figma source with component tokens. Design constraints: minimize visual noise, support colorblind-safe palette, ensure legible numeric typography at 12px, and create a variant that demonstrates how fallback routing changed latency distribution for a canary rollout. Avoid duplicating existing snapshot art; use new layout language (stripline + microcards) and fresh naming 'Signal Scout' to differentiate from prior quickstart packs.
acceptance_criteria: Six exported assets in specified sizes (360px, 720px, 1440px) with 2x retina PNGs
Figma file with named layers and tokens, components documented in Figma pages
Annotations for each screenshot suitable for docs (short callouts + 1–2 sentence caption)
Accessibility pass: contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for key text, colorblind palette verified
Signoff from PM (product-observability) and one engineering reviewer on telemetry accuracy
Small GIF (max 3s, optimized) that animates trace swimlane to show span waterfall
design_notes: Prefer stripline layout: horizontal latency percentiles across top, microcards below for cost and model breakdown
Use condensed numeric type for token-cost values; show per-model toggles in the modal
Create two color variants: standard and high-contrast for accessibility documentation
Thumbnail optimization: hide non-essential gridlines and use soft shadows on microcards
Include a canary vs baseline overlay option to illustrate graceful fallback behavior
